title: Equivalence of slice diagrams is detected on relative right-cone diagrams
statement:
Use the small simplicial sets, quasicategories, internal functor simplicial sets and equivalence edges of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a small quasicategory, $y$ a vertex, and $J$ any small simplicial set in the same fixed universe. Let $S_y$ have $n$-simplices $\sigma:\Delta^{n+1}\to\mathcal C$ with last vertex $y$, and operators given by extending $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$ to $\alpha^+:[m+1]\to[n+1]$ with $\alpha^+(m+1)=n+1$. Define the right cone $J^{\triangleright}=J\star\Delta^0$ by adjoining a last vertex $*$: besides the simplices of $J$ and the constant simplices at $*$, its simplices are concatenations of a simplex of $J$ and a nonempty constant simplex at $*$, with operators given by restricting the two ordered blocks. Thus $(\Delta^n)^{\triangleright}=\Delta^{n+1}$.
For a simplicial map $e:J\to S_y$, let $F_e:J^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal C$ be the corresponding cone diagram: for each simplex $a:\Delta^n\to J$ its restriction along $a^{\triangleright}:\Delta^{n+1}\to J^{\triangleright}$ is the simplex $e_n(a)$; in particular $F_e(*)=y$. Put
$$\mathcal A_J=\operatorname{Fun}(J^{\triangleright},\mathcal C)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_*,\mathcal C}\{y\}.$$
Here an $r$-simplex in the strict fiber $\mathcal A_J$ is a map $J^{\triangleright}\times\Delta^r\to\mathcal C$ whose restriction to $\{*\}\times\Delta^r$ is constant at $y$. For any two simplicial maps $e_0,e_1:J\to S_y$, there exists an equivalence edge between $e_0,e_1$ in $\operatorname{Fun}(J,S_y)$ if and only if there exists an equivalence edge between $F_{e_0},F_{e_1}$ in $\mathcal A_J$. Equivalence edge has its inverse-and-two-triangle meaning, in both simplicial sets.
